## R Markdown

In class work for Week-5

```{r}
n_values <- c(1, 5, 20, 100)
B <- 10000

colors <- c("blue", "green", "orange", "purple")

# Set up an empty plot
plot(
  NA,
  xlim = c(-4, 4),
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "CDF",
  main = "Convergence in Distribution to N(0,1)"
)

for (i in 1:length(n_values)) {

  n <- n_values[i]

  x <- rnorm(
    B,
    mean = 0,
    sd = sqrt(1 + 1/n)
  )

  F_hat <- ecdf(x)

  curve(
    F_hat(x),
    from = -4,
    to = 4,
    add = TRUE,
    col = colors[i],
    lwd = 2
  )
}

# Limiting theoretical CDF
curve(
  pnorm(x),
  from = -4,
  to = 4,
  add = TRUE,
  col = "black",
  lwd = 3,
  lty = 2
)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c(
    paste("n =", n_values),
    "N(0,1)"
  ),
  col = c(colors, "black"),
  lwd = c(rep(2, 4), 3),
  lty = c(rep(1, 4), 2),
  bty = "n"
)


mtext(
  "Convergence in Distribution to N(0,1)",
  outer = TRUE,
  cex = 1.3
)

```

```{r}

#sample_size <- c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000)
sample_size <- c(5, 50, 200,1000)

par(
  mfrow = c(2, 2),
  oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0)
)


sim_size <- 10000
mean_vector <- numeric(sim_size)

for (i in 1:length(sample_size)){
  
  n = sample_size[i]
  
  for (j in 1:sim_size){
    x = rexp(n=n, rate = 1/5)
    x_bar = mean(x)
    mean_vector[j] <- x_bar
    
  }
  
  hist(
    mean_vector,
    probability = TRUE,
    main = paste("n =", n),
    xlab = "x",
    xlim = c(0, 10)
  )
  
  curve(
    dnorm(x, mean = 5, sd = 1 / sqrt(n)),
    add = TRUE,
    col = "red",
    ylim = 1.0,
    lwd = 2
  )
  
  
}

mtext(
    "CLT Simulation for exponential dist. ",
    outer = TRUE,
    side = 3,
    line = 1,
    cex = 1.5,
    font = 2
  )
```
